title: spinup-skein-shadow-diffusion-oct29-2026
summary: Notes from the 2026-10-29 perf sync: anomalous 95th latency rise on mixed-workload spinup shadow runs; tests and hypotheses; action items assigned.
content:
Attendees: Liam, Priya, Elliot, Sophie (+ on-call: Marco in the thread).

Agenda:
- Quick recap of last week's warmpath experiment.
- Review shadow-run output from 10/28-10/29 (spinup skein config).
- Hypotheses for 95th/99th latency increase on mixed-100 workload.
- Decide next triage runs and short-term mitigations.

Observed summary:
- Run set: spinup-skein-shadow v2 (config: batch_limit=32, kv_cache_enabled=true, priming_policy=gradual), replaying production traces for region us-west-2.
- Regression window: baseline (2026-10-22) -> new runs (2026-10-28).
- Key metric delta: 95th latency for mixed-100 sequences increased from ~142ms -> ~163ms (+15%), 99th increased from 260ms -> 315ms (+21%). Mean token time stable (+3%). Throughput steady within 5% of baseline.
- Error rates unchanged. No backend OOMs observed.

What we looked at:
- KV cache hit distribution: saw increased misses in first 6 tokens of requests (miss rate bump from 9% -> 18%). Pattern suggests prefix priming/scheduling difference.
- Scheduler traces: a higher proportion of small batches (1-3) on the critical path during the first 200ms after pod spin-up. The batching heuristic appears to under-aggregate short-lived inflight requests under v2 scheduler.
- Sequencer logs: more frequent preemption events coincident with K/V cache cold fills.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Scheduler heuristic tweak in v2 inadvertently lowers aggregation window during spinup windows, increasing micro-latency for early tokens.
2) New priming_policy=gradual causes more distributed KV writes and increases contention on the cache write path (especially when combined with the new GPU memcpy throttle in patch #3162).
3) Trace sampling artifact: the replay generator used a slightly different arrival pattern (spikey inter-arrival times) — need to validate with raw trace compare.

Quick experiments run during sync:
- A: Repeat shadow with priming_policy=immediate (same spinup-skein v2). Result: 95th dropped to ~146ms (close to baseline).
- B: Force scheduler back to v1 aggregation window (local override) -> 95th at ~144ms.
- C: Disable memcpy throttle (dev kernel flag) -> small improvement (~4% at 99th) but not sufficient alone.
These indicate interaction between scheduler and priming more than memcpy throttle alone.

Temporary mitigation (agreed):
- Roll priming_policy back to immediate for the next 48h shadow runs in us-west-2 (Priya to deploy config change).
- Add a short-term scheduler override for spinup windows to force larger aggr_window_ms=12 (Elliot will push a feature-flagged change).

Open questions:
- Why did v2 scheduler change land without regression in our CI? CI workloads didn't exercise spinup-heavy traces. Need to add a dedicated spinup-skein case to CI.
- Is there a hidden dependency between the priming write pattern and the cache lock implementation that scales poorly under distributed priming? (Sophie to instrument lock contention counters).
- Do we have correlated anomalies in Dedicated/Private customers? (Marco/CS asked to scan support logs for any similar tail-latency complaints in last 7 days).

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Priya: Deploy priming_policy=immediate to shadow cluster us-west-2 and run 12h back-to-back replay. Collect detailed KV hit/miss by token index. ETA: 2026-10-30 10:00 PT.
- Elliot: Feature-flag scheduler aggr_window override + run canary shadow. Push PR and link to RINF-8421. ETA: 2026-10-31 COB.
- Sophie: Add lock contention counters to cache write path and wire them to perf dashboards (temp retention 7d). ETA: 2026-11-02.
- Liam: Add spinup-heavy synthetic case to nightly CI (seeded arrival patterns) and baseline acceptance test. ETA: 2026-11-04.
- Marco (on-call): Look for customer reports and file any related incidents into RINF-8460. ETA: 2026-10-30 EOD.

Notes-to-self / scratch commands used during triage:
- ./scripts/run_shadow_replay --cfg spinup-skein-v2 --window 12h --out /tmp/shadow-1029
- jq '.metrics | {p95, p99, mean}' /tmp/shadow-1029/summary.json
- python tools/kv_stats.py --input /tmp/shadow-1029/traces --group-by token_index --top 20

References and links: JIRA RINF-8421 (scheduler aggr change), PR #3162 (memcpy throttle), PR #3178 (spinup-skein v2 config), slack thread perf-bench: https://slack.redwood/perf-bench/thread-2938

Retrospective note:
- We need a better labeling and perf-tagging scheme for config permutations so shadow runs are comparable (today naming drift made it harder to see that priming_policy changed between runs). Liam to propose a minimal schema next sync.

Next sync: 2026-11-02 09:30 PT. Topic: test results from Priya + canary scheduler override.

End of notes.
notes_brief: Immediate action: rollback priming_policy; schedule scheduler aggr override; instrument cache write lock; add spinup case to CI.
